Chapter 6768: Immortals, Please Show Mercy

Chapter 6768: Immortals, Please Show Mercy

Although Dragon Ancestor had never seen an immortal, she understood the implication of such a being.

She could barely see traces of cultivation in Xiaoyue but as for the man, he certainly possessed a mortal body untouched by cultivation.

It was one thing for the immortals to purposely hide their cultivation. However, Li Qiye didn’t appear to be doing so.

This tempted her enough to use her heavenly gaze. This only confirmed that Li Qiye’s mortal body was devoid of any dao aura.

“Take out the divine artifact.” Xiaoyue commanded.

“May I ask where you are from, Immortals?” The skeptical ancestor took a deep breath.

If they were real immortals, then it wouldn’t be up to her. However, she didn’t believe it just yet. After all, how could she hand over the sect’s legacy heirloom so frivolously?

“Still want to keep looking?” Xiaoyue appeared annoyed.

Not to mention an insignificant ancient ancestor and this divine artifact, she could grasp all of Beastmaster in an instant.

The difference between an ancient ancestor and an immortal was insurmountable. Thus, she was being rather patient by not just crushing the ancestor and seizing the divine artifact.

“I am only looking for evidence given the gravity of the situation...” Dragon Ancestor took a deep breath, trying to directly accuse the two of not being immortals.

This hesitation frightened Phoenix Emperor who had confirmed their identity.

“Fellow Daoists, both are immortals...” He whispered.

“Really?” Dragon Ancestor didn’t want to hand over the divine artifact based on his belief alone: “Is there any proof?”

Xiaoyue only respected Li Qiye, not other creatures whom she deemed as ants.

“Proof? You are courting death.” She reached for Dragon Ancestor.

“No!” Phoenix Emperor shouted.

“Dragon Soar!” Dragon Ancestor chanted and a draconic roar resounded.

The three-treasure dragon sent its aura toward Xiaoyue. Rumor has it this dragon had the bloodline of a true dragon, far more powerful than a regular ancestor.

“Little worm.” Xiaoyue glared at it, scaring the soul out of the dragon.

It fell, becoming as docile as a worm instead of a ferocious dragon.

She continued reaching for Dragon Ancestor. The latter was horrified since she knew how powerful her dragon was.

Nevertheless, the peak ancestor still shouted: “Myriad Dragons Recall!”

She summoned several ancestral weapons, suppressing the crowd.

“Bam!” Xiaoyue crushed all of them to her horror.

“Bixi Slash!” She took out a divine artifact and burned her true blood.

This was an axe with a white blade, seemingly made from a jawbone.

This was the famous divine artifact of Yellow Sky, one of the three made from the mystical beast.

Her attack was far stronger than Venerable Dragon Lord’s slash earlier. Mountains nearby crumbled.

“Damn!” The crowd felt its incredible power, rendering them helpless.

However, Xiaoyue caught it with her hand.

“An immortal!” This naturally confirmed it for Dragon Ancestor: “I was wrong...”

Alas, it was too late as Xiaoyue suppressed her to the ground, causing her to vomit blood.

Xiaoyue just needed to add a bit more strength and she would be reduced to blood.

“Please show mercy, Immortal!” Phoenix Emperor bowed immediately.

Of course, she had no consideration for his wish and turned toward Li Qiye instead.

“Immortal, please spare her.” Phoenix Emperor begged Li Qiye since he had the final authority.
